title: SCRUM-86: PwD - Handle Missing, Unsafe, or Disabled Links - Accessibility Test Plan
overview: Accessibility test plan for missing/unsafe/disabled links: placeholder messages visible and announced via role=alert, error states use non-color cues (icons/text), contrast ≥4.5:1, Contact Vendor fallback accessible, hidden links removed from AT, no dead links in tab order, keyboard accessible.

testCases.title: Placeholder message for unavailable link has role=alert
steps: Navigate to product with flagged/expired link
Verify role=alert or aria-live on message

testCases.title: Placeholder message text is descriptive
steps: Verify text like 'Link temporarily unavailable. Please check with vendor.'

testCases.title: Error states use non-color cues (icons or text)
steps: Verify icon or text label present
Verify not conveyed by color alone

testCases.title: Missing links hidden — button not rendered
steps: Navigate to product with missing link
Verify corresponding button is not in DOM
Verify not just visually hidden but still focusable
expectedResults: Missing link button hidden from AT

testCases.title: No dead/blank links in tab order
steps: Tab through all interactive elements on product page
Verify no blank or dead links receive focus

testCases.title: Contact Vendor fallback remains accessible
steps: Navigate to product with unavailable purchase links
Verify Contact Vendor button still visible

testCases.title: Unsafe link warning icon has accessible label
steps: If warning icon present for unsafe link
Verify icon has aria-label or visually hidden text

testCases.title: Placeholder message keyboard accessible
steps: Verify placeholder message area reachable or announced

testCases.title: Disabled link not just grayed out — programmatically hidden
steps: Verify display:none or not in DOM

testCases.title: Placeholder message accessible on mobile viewport
